build_classifier_argparse: build an argparse parser to configure classifier input, network, learning, and output options for fashion classification
run_option_parser: run option_parser to parse command-line arguments for texture features, shape features, and pretrained model paths
test_classifier_network_arch: test the option_parser with --network_arch mlp to verify MLP classifier architecture arguments are parsed correctly
review_option_parser_defaults: review the option_parser defaults for learning rate, max iterations, and stop criterion settings
summarize_classifier_options: summarize the option_parser arguments covering input files, network architecture, generator models, and output generation options
